title: Leader versus manager in the Superior Band photo
summary: Bocage explains that as violinist-leader he started the band and chose the music while the manager handled business; the photo dates to about 1908.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Oh, the manager was a fellow. He took care of the job, you know. The business part. Yeah, the business part.
Mm-hmm. I run the band when he's on the stands. Well, who picked the-
Did you stop off? How did you start the band? You started playing?
That's the way we did those. The violin player always did that. Yeah, always stop and start the band. And I selected whatever the band had to play. Yeah, right.
